_comment: ADR-0010's anti-hollowing manifest. Adding a gate JOB to a workflow requires appending its job id here in the same change -- gate-integrity.ts fails any workflow file missing a job id listed for it below. Removing a gate therefore means editing this file too, which is the loud, reviewable diff the decision wants. Only WORKFLOW JOB IDS belong here: a moon task run inside an existing job (every root:* gate runs inside `ci` via `moon ci`) does not get its own entry.
